text.tspan: Practice each bar separately, then connect 43–45 and aim the whole passage toward the low point at measure 46.
Measures 46–54: Long cadential drive to the end of the first half.
Practice 46–49, 50–52, and 53–54, then play 46–54 as one directed phrase toward the cadence.
Measures 55–64: Opening of the second half — dominant arpeggiation and transition into the next harmonic region.
Practice 55–59 and 60–64. Measures 63–64 must stay together because Bach's slur begins in 63 and resolves in 64.
Measures 63–69: Overlap into the C-minor region and new sequential motion.
Begin with measure 63 so the original 63→64 slur is preserved. Then practice the core groups 64–66 and 67–69.
